sentences.text: In MFA.8467/2018 is filed against the common award of the Tribunal in MVC.No.1159/2016 and another appeal MFA.No.8468/2018 is filed against the award of the Tribunal in MVC.No.1160/2016.
In fact, the Tribunal passed a common award in MVC.Nos.1159/2016 and 1160/2016 dated 06.12.2016.

3. Learned counsel for the appellant mainly contended that he is not insisting for the enhancement of the compensation but requesting this Court to direct the Insurance Company to pay compensation and to recover the same from the owner of the vehicle.
As there was no Driving License, the Tribunal exonerated the Insurance Company and fixed the liability against the owner.
NC: 2025:KHC:34966 HC-KAR 4.
Considering the submissions of both sides, this Court finds that it is just and reasonable to direct the Insurance Company to pay the said amount within one month from today.

5. On such deposit, the appellants are permitted to withdraw the same along with interest accrued on it and the Insurance Company is at liberty to recover the same from the owner of the vehicle by due process of law.
Accordingly, both the appeals are partly allowed.
